input.quote: Company shall not resell or make use of said property in any other manner other than in connection with the software Company receives under this Agreement.
input.rationale: I reviewed the full outline and every section that could host a restrictive covenant (§1 Purpose of Engagement, §6 Termination, and §§4, 5 and 7), and ran targeted searches for "compet", "exclusiv", "solicit", "similar services", "restrict" and "Company shall not". The Agreement contains no non-compete, field-of-use, territory or exclusivity restriction binding Clear Capital, and no limit on the products or services we may buy, build or market. The only restriction on us is the licence-scope limit in §4(b) (p0020), which merely confines our use of RadialSpark's pre-existing proprietary materials to the software delivered under the Agreement — an IP/licence-scope provision rather than a covenant not to compete. The mutual non-solicitation of employees in §13 (p0047) is reciprocal, term plus twelve months, and limited to personnel involved in the Services, so it is a personnel restriction outside this rule's scope rather than a business or field-of-use restraint. The preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer) is therefore met and no redline is required.
